# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'

print(df['revenue'].str.contains(r'\,', regex=True).sum(), "rows contain commas")

# Check for the presence of commas in revenue
print("\nExample rows with commas:")
print(df[df['revenue'].str.contains(r'\,', regex=True)]['revenue'].head())"}
